status_lines: INDEPENDENT EVALUATION NOT AUTHORIZED OR CONDUCTED
statement: Open decisions are questions only. The recorded owner authorizations are decided and limited to their stated scope. Nothing here is recommended.

decisions.question: Whether to authorize a separately scoped Engine fix for the deferred issues (AR-040 person-directed contract language, invalid calendar dates, AR-035 legal-conclusion note, wider negation, duration, control and employment forms).
decisions.basis: Phase 7 backlog P7B-010, P7B-011, P7B-014; P7-OD-03, P7-OD-05, P7-OD-06.

decisions.question: How to handle the declared cross-package compatibility conditions CPC-01 to CPC-04: keep them visible as they are, or authorize a redesign of the earlier file-ownership checks under a recorded change.
decisions.blocks: Any edit to a Phase 4, Phase 6 or Phase 7 test.

decisions.question: Whether to preserve or commit the local Phase 6, Phase 7 and Phase 8 work, and in what private location.
decisions.basis: All three packages are local and uncommitted by instruction.
decisions.blocks: Any commit, push or transfer of the local packages.

decisions.question: Whether any future independent evaluation is authorized, and if so who fills each role and which material classes are permitted (Gate A).
decisions.blocks: Gates A to F; any statement about performance.

decisions.question: Whether the v0.3.1 candidate becomes a proposal for a successor local Engine version, remains a parked candidate, or is discarded.
decisions.blocks: Any change of the candidate status.

decisions.question: Whether the change-impact and rollback model is adopted as the rule for future Engine proposals.
How the three B-018 controlling source files will be made available for a read-only reconciliation, given they are held outside this container.
decisions.basis: B-018 OPEN; source files absent from the repository and container.
decisions.blocks: B-018 reconciliation; any statement depending on the source-aligned records.

decisions.question: Whether to ratify the retroactive later-package registry entries for Phase 6, Phase 7 and Phase 8, whose owner-decision references point to recorded assignment evidence rather than to a formal decision record.
decisions.blocks: Treating the seeded entries as formally admitted.

decisions.question: Whether the later-package registry, dual-context result model and future-package admission gate are adopted as the rule for any future local package.

owner_authorizations.question: Reference for a future local package reservation: a human evidence adjudication and review dossier layer around the v0.3.1 candidate.
owner_authorizations.basis: Owner work assignment of 2026-10-20 (Phase 9), cited again in the Phase 8.2 authorization.
owner_authorizations.decision_record: Owner instruction in session, 2026-10-20: record this exact reference as an owner decision for a future local package reservation.
owner_authorizations.blocks: Nothing; it is required by, and does not replace, the admission gate.

phase7_decisions_carried.question: Whether the v0.3.1 candidate should become a proposal for a successor local Engine version, remain a parked candidate, or be discarded. No release or deployment is implied either way.
Whether the Phase 4 ST-06 degradation (a rationale moved into the residual-risk section is now routed to review by RP-EVL-01) is acceptable over-review.
The scope boundary for person-directed contract language such as Phase 4 AR-040 ("contract will not be renewed"). Deferred: it cannot be separated lexically from supplier-contract wording.
How to treat the declared cross-package conflicts: the Phase 4 check on tools/ (from Phase 6) and the Phase 6 check that every new file is a Phase 6 file (from Phase 7).
Whether any rule should be widened (more negation forms, other duration units, other control or employment paraphrases); each widening needs a new sealed scenario set.
Whether invalid calendar dates and the AR-035 legal-conclusion note should enter a later remediation set.
Which future independent evaluation, if any, should examine the abstention and scope rules before any stronger statement is made (P6K-001, P6K-002, P6K-008).
Whether, when and where Phase 6 and Phase 7 material is committed in a public repository.
